messages:
Alex K: Quick ping — PR #4821 is staged for RC1. Can someone take a 5–10m look for tagging, changelog, and backports before we cut? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821 :eyes:
Tara M: on it. CI looks green except one flaky smoke test on aarch64, saw it locally too.
Alex K: thanks — CI info: all unit/integration passed. smoke failure: `tests/smoke/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction` flakes intermittently with `ConnectionResetError`.
Mike R: I can do changelog + tags. Do we want a short user-facing entry or keeps it internal?
Alex K: short public entry — note quantization perf tweak and a fix for KV cache eviction. Put under "Changed" + mention that a backport is required for 2.3.x. Example blurb: `Serving runtime: improved quantization kernel selection to reduce OOMs for long-context models; fixed KV cache eviction bug causing occasional connection resets (backport to 2.3.x)`.
Samir: I'll handle backport once merged. Which branch exactly? 2.3-stable or 2.3-maint? We use 2.3-stable for release tooling.
Lia: what's our cut ETA? If we cut in 30m I can freeze rollouts and run the smoke-suite again. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex K: aiming for a 45m cut but happy to hold 30m for final checks. If anyone finds a blocker call it out now.
Mike R: changelog added in the PR description and added `release-note: semver-minor`. Tagging `needs-backport` and `rc1` labels. :white_check_mark:
Tara M: re: flaky test — opened a small follow-up fix PR (4822) that retries the eviction call; CI green on that branch.
Samir: noted — will backport 4821 + 4822 together to 2.3-stable after merge. I'll attach the cherry-pick commands in a comment.
release-bot: Reminder: release window opens in 30 minutes (scheduled cut 1842511676). Please ensure PRs have release labels and changelog entries.
Lia: ok holding for 30m, i'll re-run smoke-suite at +20m and report.
Alex K: awesome, thanks everyone. @Mike R can you do the final LGTM once smoke-suite passes?
Mike R: yep will give LGTM after smoke pass. :shipit:
Alex K: will merge once Mike lgtm + CI green and then Samir can backport. I'll update the release notes page after cut.
Tara M: quick note — added `changelog: rc1` tag and a one-liner for release notes.
Samir: prep script for backport ready, will post commands in PR after merge.
Alex K: perfect — locking this thread unless anything new. Thanks all! :tada:
